snippet.title: Minesleeper Game Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
You wake up in a distant part of the universe 27.000 years after being deployed on an urgent mission to save humanity from extinction. A minesweeper gets a dangerous makeover in this hexagonal roguelite. Outsmart devious puzzles, bend the odds, and turn failures into triumph.
